//: P1-C14: the words and button names the controls cards use for sources whose mapping is not in clusters.json. The pad's Identify and READY buttons are the standard-mapping indices the host and the controller sample (View/Select is button 8, Start/Menu is 9: web/host/src/input/local.ts, web/controller/src/sources/input.ts); a test checks these two against the sampling code's constants so the cards cannot drift from the mapping. Key clusters come from web/host/src/input/clusters.json and wheels from web/host/src/input/wheels.json; the card builders take them as arguments.
